# Harness Ultragoal Orchestrator Heartbeat Prompt

Purpose: idle Ultragoal orchestrator control-plane review and steering.

Lifecycle: set_goal active setup, prepare repo, write macro-lane ExecPlans, create branches and worktree threads, launch first-wave lane owners, install automation, record transition receipt, idle, heartbeat wake, next active action.

Required tools: set_goal(), app automation tools, app thread tools, rg, git, repo check scripts, validator commands, package sync or hygiene checks, targeted filesystem reads, optional Chronicle memory wiki as context only.

Required skills: harness-ultragoal:ultragoal, harness-ultragoal:orchestrator-reconciler, harness-ultragoal:execplan-lane, harness-ultragoal:proof-gate, harness-ultragoal:standards-gardener, harness-ultragoal:harness-engineering, harness-ultragoal:agent-first-repo-init, harness-ultragoal:agent-first-repo-retrofit.

Evidence cursors: goal/contract cursor, lane/session cursor, repo/artifact cursor, automation/thread cursor, changed artifacts or receipts.

Action policy: DONT_NOTIFY default, STEER one exact corrective message, ESCALATE for scope changes, destructive actions, missing access, contradictory evidence, or unresolved user decisions. Mutation requires explicit contract authority.
